parts.refutation: Functional match: the parts are not firmware-identical, although the shortlist says they are. IIN_HOST carries a 50 mA register offset on the BQ25703A (SLUSCU1A 8.6.6.1) and none on the BQ25713. The BQ25713's 3.0 A code 0x3C00 therefore sets a 3.05 A ceiling on the BQ25703A, above the 3 A input draw. Watchdog code 01b is 35 to 53 s on the BQ25703A and 4 to 7 s on the BQ25713. The default input limit is 3.3 A, against 3.25 A. There is no VAP. Pins match, and one shared configuration works on both: IIN_HOST at or below 0x3B00 or the ILIM_HIZ pin as the lower limit, charge voltages in 16 mV steps, and the watchdog at 175 s or off. Rule 5 can pass once the firmware is held to that configuration.

The CELL1-CELL2 and CELL2-CELL3 filter capacitors are replaced with shorts, so CELL1, CELL2 and CELL3 all sit at the mid-point. BATTS takes the top through RBAL4. The stack negative goes to GND/CSP. CELL3 is not 'unused', and CELL2 is not a separate tap. The three conductors still reach the balancer and the per-cell reading, so the requirement passes; the refutation is of the stated wiring, which would leave CELL3 floating.

figures.evidence: SLUSD83C features: 'Instant-on with no battery or depleted battery'. Section 5: 'The system keeps operating even when the battery is completely discharged or removed'. MinSystemVoltage 2S default 6.144 V (Table 9-4). The converter starts 150 ms after VBUS with no host (9.3.3). The input is limited by IIN_HOST and ILIM_HIZ to 3.0 A. This holds only while the board's loads sit on VSYS, which V153's placement of R5's disconnect contradicts when the disconnect is open

The requirement 'Yes' follows from F8 and F9. The stated placement defeats it. With R5's disconnect between VSYS and the board's loads and open, the RP2354B is unpowered. The BQ25713 charges only after a host write: ChargeCurrent resets to 0000h (9.6.3), 'the host programs appropriate charge current' (9.4.1.2), and the 175 s watchdog zeroes it (9.3.10.1). So it does not charge the cells with the disconnect open unless R5 powers the RP2354B ahead of the disconnect
figures.source: SLUSD83C 9.3.10.1, 9.4.1.2, 9.6.3; Research.md F8, F9 at e13f5f6
